menu_items.name: Papaya & Pig Ear Salad - Goi Du Du
menu_items.description: Green papaya, watercress, crispy pig ear, herbs, peanuts, sweet soy dressing

menu_items.name: Poached Shrimp Salad - Goi Tom
menu_items.description: With cabbage, grapefruit, herbs, candied cashews & coconut-lime dressing

menu_items.name: Sautéed Clams - Ngao Xao
menu_items.description: Manila clams, stewed tomatoes, garlic, rau ram & a crispy breadstick

menu_items.description: Fresh rice paper wrapped around cucumber, lettuce, mint and thai basil with peanut-hoisin sauce. Pork Sausage, Tofu or One of Each

menu_items.description: Crab & pork spring rolls with classic nuoc cham and herbs

menu_items.name: Grilled Shishito Peppers
menu_items.description: With shrimp salt & lime

menu_items.name: Morning Glory - Rau Muong
menu_items.description: Sautéed with garlic & fish sauce

menu_items.name: Spicy Garlic Cauliflower - Sup Lo Cay
menu_items.description: Chili butter, fish sauce, lime

menu_items.name: Classic Hanoi Style Beef - Pho Bac (Two Meats)
menu_items.description: 24-hour heritage Black Angus beef broth. Rich & aromatic. Choose your meats: Rare Filet Mignon*, Brisket, Oxtail, Tendon. Two meats option.

menu_items.name: Classic Hanoi Style Beef - Pho Bac (Three Meats)
menu_items.description: 24-hour heritage Black Angus beef broth. Rich & aromatic. Choose your meats: Rare Filet Mignon*, Brisket, Oxtail, Tendon. Three meats option.

menu_items.name: House Special - Dac Biet
menu_items.description: The works! Our classic 24-hour broth with filet mignon*, brisket, oxtail, bone marrow and a crispy breadstick.

menu_items.name: Chicken - Pho Ga
menu_items.description: Pure chicken bliss

menu_items.name: Vegetarian - Pho Chay
menu_items.description: Mushroom & ginger broth with leafy greens, cauliflower, mixed mushrooms and tofu

menu_items.name: Shaking Beef - Bo Luc Lac
menu_items.description: Filet mignon, garlic-butter soy, bone marrow, watercress salad & steamed rice
